name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
Reliability update since v3.29.3

🛟 Nothing stays on screen that the server rejected — when a concurrent edit makes the server refuse a save, the assignee distribution now rolls back to what is really stored and freezes further edits until you reload, with the reason spelled out instead of a silent failure.

🔁 The app no longer conflicts with itself on startup — reconciling working copies used to send two competing history writes at load, so the second was always refused and every later edit failed with it.

🧹 The clear button in settings selectors really clears — the field showed «not selected», the save reported success, and the old value came back after a reload. Optional fields can be switched off again.

🔄 «Refresh from issue» no longer drops assignees set in the planner when Quick edit is off: an empty role field in YouTrack is expected in that mode and is no longer treated as an unassignment.

📊 Backlog capacity bar stopped overstating the available resource 60×, so the overload warning works again.

🚦 A failed project load looks like a failure, not like an empty project, and a hung request now times out.

🌍 Language reaches the whole app — settings, backlog, stand-up and every date follow the planner language, not the browser locale.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
